Connect your Sofle

Plug the keyboard in over USB, then press Connect and choose it in the browser prompt. Nothing changes until you edit something.

Try the demo

This browser can't talk to the keyboard (no WebHID). Use Chrome or Edge on desktop, over https or http://localhost. Firefox and Safari don't support it. The demo still works.

How this works

  1. Pick a layer, then click a key to colour it. Shift+click selects several.
  2. Preview is live: every change shows on the keyboard at once, and is lost if it loses power.
  3. Save writes to the keyboard's flash so it stays. The Save button lights up when there is something to save.
